{"consolidated_memory":"**Component:** worker/scheduler/cron.py (background jobs side)
**Problem Pattern:** Missed run in the scheduler (repeated across three separate occasions)
**Reproduction Method:** Advance the fake clock across the schedule (consistent across all occasions)
**Signal:** A slot with no execution record (consistent across all occasions)

---

**OCCASION 1: [2026-01-21]**
- Root Cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Trigger Condition: Only affected tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #2525 on branch fix/missed-run-1
- Measured Outcome: Memory settled at 393 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB

---

**OCCASION 2: [2026-03-18]**
- Root Cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Trigger Condition: Only manifested after the client had already retried once
- Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #2689 on branch fix/missed-run-2
- Measured Outcome: The nightly rollup matched the source counts for 42 days running

---

**OCCASION 3: [2026-04-23]**
- Root Cause: A mutable default argument shared across calls
- Trigger Condition: Only affected records carrying non-ASCII names
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #8388 on branch fix/missed-run-3
- Measured Outcome: Throughput rose 23 percent, to 415 requests per second

---

**Context:** All three fixes target the same corner of worker/scheduler/cron.py, with context carrying over between occasions."}
